classifications.rationale: The loop attempts to unpack each six-element tuple into two variables, raising ValueError before any candidate comparison runs. The intended core-precedence assertions are valid, but the test data and unpacking are inconsistent.
classifications.contract_basis: Version.compare must decide differing major, minor, or patch components before examining prereleases, including prereleases whose legacy integer conversion would fail (acceptance criterion 9).

modules.corrected_notes: Changed the malformed core-version cases to pairs of three-component tuples and passed each tuple to its respective constructor. The assertions still enforce core precedence before prerelease conversion; all other tests remain unchanged.
